title: Local AI

card.share: {percent} % of the agents' tokens stayed local ({days} days)

classesDescription: Local AI never replaces a configured model: where it is on, it is tried first, and the configured model answers whenever it is off, down, too slow or wrong. A kind of work can be switched on once its evaluation passed.

servers.title: Model servers
servers.description: Lemonade on this machine (GPU and NPU) or another OpenAI-compatible server. Its models appear in every model picker while local AI is on.
servers.none: No server yet. Install local AI with native/local-ai/install.sh, then add it here.
servers.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Agents fall back to their configured models.
servers.name: Name

presets.title: Preset
presets.description: Switches the kinds of work at once, as far as their evaluations passed.
presets.sparsamHint: Everything that passed its evaluation runs locally first; saves the most subscription limit.
presets.ausgewogenHint: Embeddings, Hermes' helper calls, summaries, triage and transcription locally; agents' real work stays on the configured models.
presets.qualitaetHint: Only embeddings and transcription locally; everything else on the configured models.
presets.eigeneHint: The kinds of work as set below.

embeddings.label: Embeddings (search)
embeddings.description: Vectors for semantic search in the knowledge base; while the server is down, search answers from full text.

hermes-helpers.label: Hermes helper calls
hermes-helpers.description: Context compression and image descriptions; the agent's main model answers when the local one fails.

summaries.label: Summaries and digests
summaries.description: Update digests, run, activity and mail summaries, briefings.

triage.label: Triage and routing
triage.description: Sorting incoming work: category, priority, which agent.

transcription.label: Transcription (dictation)
transcription.description: Speech to text for dictation and voice mode (Whisper on the NPU).

routines.label: Routine agents
routines.description: Scheduled routines try the local workhorse model first, with the agent's configured model as fallback.

reflection.label: Nightly reflection
reflection.description: What a run taught, skill curation: batch work at night on the heavy local model.

coordinator-triage.label: Coordinator first pass
coordinator-triage.description: A coordinator's first look at a new task; anything real escalates to its configured model.

decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.description: Typed decisions by logit readout: sorting mail, model choice, receipts, the workflow step. The kinds are switched on under Decisions.

updates.label: Local AI
updates.hint: Update through native/local-ai/install.sh, then evaluate again.

problems.evalFailedDetail: {model} – the configured model answers until an eval passes
